validated_results.title: Do preserved foods increase prostate cancer risk?
validated_results.reason: This hospital-based case-control study assessed fermented soy product intake in relation to incident prostate cancer risk.

extraction.population: Hospital-based inpatient cases and controls in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, China

sample_size.location: Abstract; total_n derived from reported group counts 130 + 274 = 404

design.excerpt: A hospital based 1 : 2 case–control design was used.
design.location: Materials and Methods, Study design and participants, paragraph 1

timing.excerpt: A reference recall period was set at 5 years before diagnosis for cases or 5 years before interview for controls.

continent.excerpt: The possible relationship between preserved foods and prostate cancer was investigated in a case–control study in southeast China

exposure_measurement.excerpt: The quantitative Food Frequency Questionnaire (FFQ) component on habitual diet was modified from that used in the Shanghai stomach cancer study

parallel_r3_gate_reasons: JBI remains Fair after Claude R2
important quantitative evidence remains missing or invalid: ci_lower, ci_upper, comparison_type, effect_size, effect_type, p_value
